item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
Issued at 07:00 PM 17 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #AgusanDelNorte(LasNieves), #MisamisOriental(Claveria), #SurigaoDelSur(Tagbina, Barobo, Lianga), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dimataling, Pitogo, Tabina, Bayog), #LanaoDelSur(Picong, Malabang, Balabagan, Kapatagan, Madamba, Ganassi, Tubaran, Binidayan, Bayang, LumbacaUnayan, Lumbatan, SultanDumalondong, Butig, Lumbayanague, Wao, Masiu, PoonaBayabao), #DavaoDelNorte(SanIsidro, Asuncion), #DavaoDeOro(Montevista), #LanaoDelNorte(SultanNagaDimaporo, Sapad), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Buldon, Barira, Matanog), #NorthCotabato(Alamada, Banisilan), #Bukidnon(Damulog, Kibawe, Kadingilan, Dangcagan, DonCarlos, Maramag, CityOfValencia, Cabanglasan, Lantapan, CityOfMalaybalay, Libona, Pangantucan), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Baliguian, Kalawit), #AgusanDelSur(LaPaz, Rosario, CityOfBayugan, Sibagat, Esperanza, SanLuis, Talacogon, Prosperidad, SanFrancisco), #ZamboangaSibugay(Malangas, Imelda and Payao) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan, RosellerLim, Titay, Ipil, Naga, Kabasalan, Siay, Diplahan), #DavaoDelNorte(Kapalong, Talaingod), #DavaoDeOro(Laak, Monkayo, Compostela), #SurigaoDelSur(Hinatuan, CityOfBislig, Lingig), #DavaoOriental(Boston, Cateel), #ZamboangaCity, #LanaoDelSur(Calanogas, Pagayawan, Pualas, Marogong), #LanaoDelNorte(Nunungan), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sibuco, Sirawai, Siocon), #Bukidnon(Kitaotao, Quezon, SanFernando, Sumilao, ManoloFortich, Malitbog, ImpasugOng), #AgusanDelSur(SantaJosefa, Veruela, Trento, Loreto and Bunawan) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
